Streaming chat completion via Azure OpenAI — verifies the azure/ prefix routes correctly and SSE chunks are delivered in the standard OpenAI chat.completion.chunk shape

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { createClient } from "@xberg-io/liter-llm";
async function main() {
  const client = createClient("your-api-key");
  const result = await client.chatStream({ messages: [{ content: "Count to 3", role: "user" }], model: "azure/gpt-4", stream: true, temperature: 0 });
  console.log(result.chunks);
  console.log(result.streamContent);
  console.log(result.streamComplete);
}

void main();
```
